pin_cites.parenthetical: "If the case has merit and a trial is required counsel should be appointed. The prisoner himself can simply not prepare and try the case effectively"

where an indigent prisoner is in no position to investigate his case, his complaint states a cause of action, and the appointment of counsel will advance the administration of justice, the case will be remanded with directions to the district court to appoint counsel
"If it is apparent to the district court that a pro se litigant has a colorable claim but lacks the capacity to present it, the district court should appoint counsel to assist him"
